title: The Phantom Echo
narrative_purpose: Establish Elena's present state of profound despair and isolation, immediately immersing the audience in the central mystery of her dissolving identity and the psychological impact.
camera_style: Clinical observation, slow push, fragmented close-ups, wide shots emphasizing isolation
color_palette: Stark blue-white (screens), deep oppressive shadows, desaturated tones
lighting: Harsh screen-glow, deep shadows, single key light (implied by monitor light)
music: Subliminal electronic drone, low bass pulse
transition_out: Narrator leads to fade to black

title: Rewind to the Precipice
narrative_purpose: Transition the narrative timeline to the past, setting up the origin story of Elena's crisis and building anticipation for the flashback.
transition_in: From previous scene's narrator and fade out

title: Identity Not Found
narrative_purpose: Introduce Elena Vasquez in a state of extreme distress, revealing the core conflict of her identity being erased, and establish the series' paranoid, tech-driven atmosphere.
emotion: Paranoia, dread, despair, exhaustion, clinical detachment
camera_style: Tight shot on trembling hands, slow widen to reveal chaotic war room, close-up on distorted screen reflection (flickering glitch), pull back to wide shot emphasizing isolation. Inspired by Mr. Robot's precise, often isolating framing and True Detective's atmospheric wide shots.
color_palette: Desaturated blues, stark blue-white screen glow, deep oppressive shadows, hints of warm amber from incidental lights
lighting: Dominant harsh blue-white screen light, deep practical shadows, minimal ambient light. Reminiscent of Sicario's high contrast and selective illumination.
visual_motif: Screens, reflections (especially distorted), data interfaces, wires, claustrophobic interiors
music: Low, persistent electronic drone, subtle bass pulse, almost subliminal

title: Three Days Earlier
narrative_purpose: Provide a clear temporal transition to a flashback sequence, signaling a shift to the origin story of Elena's crisis.
camera_style: Fade to black, holding on black
music: Electronic drone fades out, replaced by clean, sterile ambient tone
